Subject: Calendar invite timezone mismatch — Nebula Retail walkthrough

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time to get a walkthrough scheduled. I just sent an invite for our standard 45-minute demo and a short agenda PDF (attached). I proposed May 22 at 14:00 UTC which should map to 15:00 CET for the lead EU attendees.

Two quick asks: can you confirm whether your calendar displays the invite as 15:00 local for you and your team? We sometimes see calendar clients default to a different timezone label and I want to avoid a situation where your head of retail joins late.

If the 14:00 UTC slot doesn't work, we can move it +/- 1 hour — Priya and Jonas are flexible on the window that day.

Agenda attached: brief intro (5m), walkthrough (30m), Q&A and next steps (10m).

Thanks,

Thanks Markus — quick heads up: the invite appears as 10:00 for one of our US-based stakeholders (they're in ET), and 15:00 for our EU folks. Our admin also forwarded a screenshot — apparently when they accepted, their client translated the event to the organizer timezone rather than participant timezone.

We have two constraints: our US ops lead is traveling that morning and can't join before 11:00 ET, and our regional rollout sync happens at 15:30 CET that day which would overlap if we run late. Would you be able to move to 16:00 CET / 15:00 UTC so there's a clear separation?

If not, our admin can propose an alternate time. Apologies — calendar quirks + travel combined here.

Best,
Sarah Gomez
Head of Platform Programs | Nebula Retail

Sarah —

Thanks for the details and the screenshot (appended below). We dug into this on our side — looks like the original invite was created in UTC but your scheduling domain enforces organizer-local display. To avoid any cross-region confusion and the travel conflict you called out, we can do either:

- Option A (preferred): Move to May 22, 16:00 CET / 15:00 UTC (which should be 11:00 ET) — that keeps the EU slot late afternoon and gives your US lead time after travel.
- Option B: Keep earlier slot but split into two short windows and record the walkthrough for the US team to watch asynchronously.

I updated and re-sent the calendar invite with the attendee timezone explicitly set to CET and included a role-based dial-in (no reliance on the organizer timezone). Please let me know if your admin sees it as 16:00 CET on their side. I also attached a quick screenshot of how it renders in Google Calendar (calendar-screenshot.png).

If Option A works, consider this confirmed once we see acceptance from scheduling@nebula-retail.com and your US lead.

Cheers,
Markus
